annotations.title: Put a file in a drive or a workbook

description: Puts a file into a connected drive or a workbook's attachments. With `text`, writes that text as the file at `path` in a drive (/googledrive/<folders>/<name>), folders made, a file already there overwritten: how a markdown file is put in a drive, since the bash shell cannot write to one. Without it, for a file too large to send inline: returns a link to PUT the file to; then call again with `upload_id` to file it.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, when known: one over the limit is refused before uploading.

text.description: The file's whole content, as text.

upload_id.description: Once the file is PUT: the upload_id the link came with.

name: upload
